title: Tech Note: [3rd Party Tech Note] Fuzzy Matching Algorithms for Sets and Binary Properties
author: David Adams

historical_commentary.text: This is a math/algorithms note (Jaccard index, Simple Matching Coefficient, Sørensen–Dice) rather than a 4D-API-specific note, so the substantive content is essentially timeless and unaffected by 4D's Design Mode-to-Project Mode or ORDA transitions. The 4D-specific implementation detail (working with classic 4D Sets) is now a legacy technique, but the underlying similarity-scoring algorithms remain exactly as valid and applicable today, whether implemented against Sets, entity selections, or plain collections.
related_updates: The mathematical algorithms (Jaccard, SMC, Sørensen-Dice) are unchanged and remain standard techniques
Implementation could be modernized using ORDA entity selections/collections instead of classic 4D Sets
General approach to fuzzy matching and dichotomization remains a valid data-science technique regardless of 4D version
